summary: The word "manjaniq" refers to a siege engine, similar to the Roman Onager or balista. It was used to hurl projectiles.
lane: [ مَنْجَنِيقٌ منجنيق , as described in art. جنق (q. v.), seems to be the engine called by the Romans Onager: see Kitto's Pict. Bible, ii. 499: but was probably applied also to the balista. ]
